sections.heading: To prepare
items: Dip each piece of fish and vegetable at a time into the batter and coat them thoroughly. Deep fry in hot oil at about 375°.
Serve the deep-fried tempura with grated white turnip in a portion of the dipping sauce.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/2 to 1 lb. absolutely fresh fish of any or all of the following types: squid, tuna, striped bass, sea bass, red snapper, salmon, abalone, or filleted porgy

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Scale, clean and bone the fish as necessary. Cut it into 1 1/2" square pieces and arrange on a serving platter. Garnish with the vegetable.
Prepare the dipping sauce using the soy sauce and wasabi to taste. Serve cold and immediately to insure freshness.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Clean the fish and marinate in sauce 1 for 15 minutes on both sides.
Slice the pork and marinate in sauce 2 for fifteen minutes.
In a large casserole, pan-fry the fish until crispy and brown. Add the rest of the ingredients and bring to a boil. Turn down and simmer, uncovered for half hour.
Add the cornstarch mixture to thicken sauce.
Sprinkle the garlic and leek on top of casserole. Heat 2 TB sesame oil separately and pour over the garlic and leek. Serve in casserole.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/4 cup scallion, cut into 1 inch long pieces

sections.heading: To cook
items: Clean the shrimp and dry with a paper towel.
Marinate the shrimp for 1/2 hour in the refrigerator.
Deep fry the shrimp in oil for 1/2 minute. Remove and drain.
Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok, brown the scallion and ginger, add the shrimp, seasoning mixture, and the nuts, and stir mixture until hot. Remove to a serving plate.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Slice the fish into 2-inch thin slices (at an angle to the backbone), with the bones in. Marinate the fish in sauce (A) for at least 4 hours.
Deep fry the fish in hot oil until it gets brown and crispy. Remove the fish from the oil and immediately soak in sauce (B) for at least 5 minutes.
Heat the leftover sauce (A) over low heat until the sauce becomes thick. Add the sesame seed oil and the fish and allow it time to soak in sauce (A). Remove to a serving platter.

sections.heading: Note
items: This fish is excellent served cold.

sections.heading: Mixture A
items: 3 sticks scallion cut into 1 inch lengths

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Cut the lobster into 2 inch serving pieces and sprinkle with the wine.
Place the lobster on a plate and steam for 5 minutes. Remove from the steam pot.

Use 3 TBS oil to stir fry the pork and mixture A until the flavor comes out. Add the steamed lobster and cook together. Add Sauce B and a little broth at a time as it is cooking. Add Sauce C to thicken the mixture then add the eggs and continue to cook until the eggs become firm.
Serve immediately on a large platter.

sections.heading: Additional Ingredients
items: 1 1/2 TBS cornstarch in 1/4 cup chicken broth

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Wash the shrimp with 1 tsp salt, rinse well and dry with a paper towel. Marinate the shrimp for at least 15 minutes and then chill them.
Quick stir fry the shrimp in 1 cup oil and drain and set aside.

Heat 3 TBS cooking oil in the wok and add A mixture, cooking until the flavor comes out (about 2 minutes). Add the ground meat and brown with A. Add the B mixture and cook together. Add the chicken broth, cover and cook for 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp to the wok mixture, add the cornstarch mixture, egg, and scallion, cook momentarily and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut fish into 2 inch strips and marinate in Sauce 1 for 15 minutes.
Dip each piece in the batter and deep fry over medium high heat til golden brown. Set aside.
In a sauce pan, saute sauce 2 in 2 TB oil til flavor comes out. Add sauce 3, and heat til thickened and glazed. Serve as a dipping sauce for the fish.

title: Steamed Fish with Black Bean Sauce

sections.heading: Seasoning Mixture
items: 1 Red pepper cut into small pieces
2 Ounces pork fat cut into small pieces

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean the fish and dry it with a towel. Rub the fish inside and out thoroughly with 1 tsp salt mixed with 1/2 tsp MSG.
Place a chopstick on the steam platter and place the fish on top of the chopstick. Cover the fish with the seasoning mixture.
Place the fish platter into the hot steamer and allow it to steam for about 12 minutes (no more than 15 minutes).
Remove the platter from the steamer and sprinkle the red pepper, sesame seed oil and scallion over the fish.
Heat the 2 TBS oil and sprinkle it hot over the scallion. Serve the fish immediately.
Soak the black beans in the water for 10 minutes and remove the water. Chop the black beans into a paste and chop in the ginger and garlic with it.
Heat 2 TBS oil to brown the mixture in (1). Add the sugar and soy sauce, cook for a short time, and it's ready to use.

sections.heading: PS
items: This black bean sauce can be kept refrigerated for a long time to be used with a variety of dishes.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean the shrimp, cut the eyes off, dry them with a towel and marinate them in the wine for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle the cornstarch over all the shrimp and deep fry them in hot oil for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Use a clean, dry wok and heat it up with just the salt and MSG (no oil). Quick roast the shrimp in the hot wok until the flavor comes out. Serve the shrimp hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean the prawn, dry them with a towel and marinate them in the wine and tsp salt.
Dust the prawn with the cornstarch and deep fry on both sides and set aside.
Stir fry the onion in a little oil until soft then remove to a serving platter.
Use 2 TBS oil to brown the hot bean sauce and add all the ingredients. Add the seasoning mixture and the prawn to the sauce, cook momentarily, and pour over the top of the onions. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Thoroughly clean the fish, rinse and dry with a paper towel. Marinate it with 1 tsp salt and 1 TBS wine for 15 minutes. Coat the fish with cornstarch and set aside.

Heat 10 cups of oil and deep fry the fish for 5 minutes. Remove it from the oil and let the oil get hot again. Deep fry the fish a second time until it is golden brown and crispy. Remove it from the heat and set aside.
Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok and stir fry the vegetables. Add the sauce mixture and cook until the sauce becomes thick. Pour the sauce over the fish on a platter and serve hot.
Fillet of fish may be used in place of a whole fish.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean the fish thoroughly, dry it, cleave it and marinate it for 30 minutes.
Sprinkle cornstarch over the fish and deep fry it until crispy. Set the fish aside.

In the wok use 2 TBS oil to brown Mixture A until the flavor comes out. Add Mixture B, cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add Mixture C to the wok and heat and stir until the sauce becomes smooth. Pour it over the fish on a platter and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 lb. fresh medium shrimp (remove shell) (or boneless chicken breast meat)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Wash shrimp and dry it with paper towel.
Marinate the shrimp in Mixture A for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Mix Batter Mixture slowly with a spoon, then dip shrimp in batter.
Deep fry in hot oil at 375 until they are a golden color.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 3 oz fat pork or 2 bacon strips

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Soak the scallion and the ginger in 1 cup of water for 15 minutes.
Use the tsp of salt to clean the shrimp and then rinse them thoroughly. Dry the shrimp with a paper towel.
Use a cleaver to crush the shrimp and then chop it up together with the pork very fine until it becomes a very smooth paste.
Add the water that the scallion and ginger soaked in 1 TBS at a time, mixing well after each spoonful. Add 3-4 TBS only.
Add the egg white, MSG, salt, food coloring, and wine and mix well. Add the cornstarch and mix well again.

Heat 6-8 cups of oil in the wok. When it is very hot, reduce the heat. Wet the left hand and squeeze a small ball of the shrimp mixture in your left hand place it in a wet spoon in your right hand and place it in the oil. Continue this until the shrimp paste is gone.

Fry the shrimp balls at 350° for 3-4 minutes until browned. Drain the oil from them and place on a platter which has been garnished with lettuce, tomato, and cucumber. One can serve the balls with a catsup dip or a bowl containing a mixture of 1 TBS salt and 1 TBS pepper.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Rinse the smelts well and dry with paper towels.
Heat oil until smoking hot and deep fry the smelts in two batches until crispy and well cooked but not burned. Set aside.
Saute Sauce 2 in two TB oil until the flavor comes out. Add Sauce 3 and stir until glazed. Add the smelts and toss until well-coated.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean the squid, carve in a pattern, and marinate in sauce 1 for 30 minutes. Use deep frying oil to quick fry the squid. As soon as it changes color remove it from the heat and set aside.
Heat the wok, brown mixture A then add mixture B and the squid as well as sauce 2. Cook for a moment and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Marinate shrimp for 15 minutes in sauce 1. Stir-fry in 1 TB oil until the color changes and remove to the side.
Use 2 TB oil and stir-fry all the ingredients. Add the shrimp and the sauce 2 and cook togeher til well blended. Serve immediately.

title: Broccoli and Scallops in Garlic Sauce

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use one TB oil to stir-fry the scallops and remove to the side.
Use one TB oil to stir-fry the broccoli and remove to the side.
Use one TB oil to stir-fry the garlic until the flavor comes out. Add the sauce ingredients and bring to a boil. It should be shiny and thick.
Add the scallops and the broccoli; mix well and serve.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Clean and carve a 1 1/2 to 2 lb fish and marinate it in the sauce for 15 minutes or more. Heat 3 TBS oil in a wok and fry the fish until both sides are brown. Add mixture A and cook until the aroma comes out of the pan.

Add mixture B ingredients and then add soup stock. Bring the mixture to a boil then reduce the heat and simmer cook with the cover on for 10 minutes or more until the sauce becomes rich and thick by adding cornstarch mixture and sesame seed oil. Serve hot.
